assertion.en: Cyanobacteria are placed in Kingdom Monera.

reason.en: Cyanobacteria make their own food by photosynthesis.

a.en: Both are true, but making food does not explain the placing. Many organisms in other kingdoms make food too.

b.en: Yes. Both are true, but cyanobacteria are in Monera because they are single-celled prokaryotes.

c.en: The reason is true: cyanobacteria are autotrophs that carry out photosynthesis.

d.en: The assertion is true: cyanobacteria are grouped under Monera.

explanation.en: Cyanobacteria do make food, but the feature that places them in Monera is the cell: single-celled, with no true nucleus. Making food alone does not decide a kingdom.
